name: New Jersey
agency: County Welfare Agency (County Board of Social Services)

period.description: Spend-down is figured over a six-month period, and you reapply every six months.

submission.description: Give your medical bills to your County Welfare Agency. Coverage can start on the first day of the six months or on the day your bills meet the spend-down.

notes: To get help with older bills, ask for retroactive coverage within six months of the date you applied.
Care received before your coverage starts is generally yours to pay.
Ask your county office what bills and proof they need for each six-month period.

sources.title: N.J.A.C. 10:70 Medically Needy Program - NJ Department of Human Services
